title: Skipping an instalment
text: You can skip one instalment at a time. Skips count toward three missed instalments in a row. A skipped instalment will not be debited, and your SIP will resume from the following month.

title: Cancelling your SIP
text: Cancelling a SIP stops future instalments only. Your accumulated units stay with you in your folio and continue to grow with the fund until you decide to redeem them.

title: Cancellation processing time
text: Under SEBI regulations, cancellation requests must be processed within 2 working days by the mutual fund company.

title: Pausing your SIP
text: A pause is offered only where the fund house allows it. Up to 3 months can be paused, requested at least 15 days before the next instalment, subject to the fund house accepting the request.

title: Pay Now for missed instalments
text: If an instalment fails due to insufficient balance, you can use Pay Now within 2 working days via NetBanking or UPI to complete the instalment for that month.

title: Changing your bank account for AutoPay
text: To change your salary or bank account, set up a new AutoPay mandate on your active bank account and link it to this SIP. The mandate must be authenticated by you with your bank.

title: AutoPay mandate approval or reset
text: If an AutoPay mandate is rejected or pending, approve the mandate request in your net banking or UPI app, or reset AutoPay with your bank.

title: Updating your KYC status
text: If an instalment fails due to KYC status, update your KYC records with the KRA or submit updated identity documents for verification before the next due date.

title: Refund timeline for debited orders without units
text: If money was debited from your bank account but units were not allocated, the full amount will be refunded to your source bank account within 7 working days.

title: Withdrawal settlement timeline
text: Mutual fund redemption requests are processed by the fund house and proceeds are credited to your verified bank account within 2 to 3 working days.

title: Exit load charges
text: Exit load is a fee charged by the mutual fund company if units are redeemed before a specified holding period (typically 1 year for equity funds).

title: ELSS tax saver lock-in period
text: ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme) mutual funds have a mandatory statutory lock-in period of 3 years from the date of each instalment.

title: SEBI three missed instalments rule
text: Under SEBI and mutual fund operating guidelines, three missed instalments in a row cancel a monthly SIP automatically.

title: Starting a new SIP after cancellation
text: A cancelled SIP cannot be resumed or un-cancelled. To continue investing in the fund, you must start a new SIP.
